title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Implementing the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting the Private Sector
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on the Implementation of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting the Private Economy

Fa Fa [2025] No. 15

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and all units of this Court:

The Supreme People's Court, taking into account the actual work of court trials, has drafted the Guiding Opinions on the Implementation of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting the Private Economy, which are hereby issued to you for implementation in light of actual circumstances. Specific issues encountered in practice shall be reported promptly level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

July 30, 2025

Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on the Implementation of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting the Private Economy

As the first basic law in China specifically dedicated to the development of the private economy, the formulation and promulgation of the Private Economy Promotion Law are landmark measures to implement the spirit of the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the symposium on private enterprises, fully demonstrating the clear stance and firm determination of the Party and the state to encourage and support the development of the private economy. In order to thoroughly implement the Private Economy Promotion Law, fully leverage the adjudication function, protect the lawful rights and interests of private economic organizations and their operators equally in accordance with the law, and promote the sustained, healthy, and high-quality development of the private economy through strict and impartial justice, the following opinions are put forth based on the actual circumstances of court trials and enforcement work.

I. Overall Requirements

Adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly study and implement Xi Jinping's Economic Thought and Xi Jinping's Thought on the Rule of Law, study and comprehend General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the symposium on private enterprises and the series of important expositions on the development of the private economy, conscientiously study, publicize, and implement the Private Economy Promotion Law, uphold and implement the "two unwaverings," continuously improve judicial policies and measures to promote the development of the private economy, promote the implementation of the requirement that "acts infringing upon the property rights and lawful interests of all forms of ownership economy shall be subject to the same liability, same crime, and same punishment," adhere to strict and impartial justice, improve adjudication rules, perfect working mechanisms, carry out specialized campaigns to regulate law enforcement and judicial actions involving enterprises in a solid manner, continuously optimize the law-based business environment, strengthen trial supervision and guidance, ensure the uniform and correct implementation of the law, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for optimizing the legal environment for private economic development and building a high-level socialist market economy system.

II. Adhere to Equal Treatment in Accordance with the Law, Ensure Fair Market Competition for All Types of Economic Organizations

1. Strictly implement the "entry permitted unless expressly prohibited" policy. Implement the national unified negative list system for market access. In the trial of civil and commercial cases involving construction projects, real estate, mineral resources, and water, electricity, gas, heat, etc., accurately grasp the impact of the relaxation of market access in natural monopoly industries and service industries on the validity of contracts, and render impartial judgments in accordance with the law. Properly adjudicate cases closely related to business operators, such as administrative licensing, administrative agreements, and administrative promises, and lawfully curb the abuse of administrative power to exclude or restrict competition, break down regional barriers and local protection, and promote the equal use of production factors by various forms of ownership economy in accordance with the law, fair participation in market competition, and equal protection under the law.

2. Improve the systems and mechanisms for administrative litigation adjudication. Adjudicate administrative agreement cases such as investment promotion agreements signed between local governments and their departments and private economic organizations, and agreements related to government and social capital cooperation projects, in accordance with the law. Improve the judicial adjudication rules for administrative agreement cases, reasonably determine the rights and obligations of all parties, and resolve issues concerning the distribution of investment returns and the sharing of liability risks fairly and legally, thereby contributing to a favorable investment and market environment. Adjudicate administrative cases involving administrative compulsory measures in accordance with the law, promote the lawful and standardized application of administrative compulsory measures against private economic organizations and their operators, and prevent adverse impacts on the normal production and operation activities of private economic organizations. Strengthen the adjudication of administrative cases involving administrative penalties against private economic organizations, and lawfully correct "heavy penalties for minor faults" and administrative penalties that are disproportionate to the nature, circumstances, severity, and social harm of the illegal act. Strengthen the adjudication of administrative cases involving expropriation or requisition of property of private economic organizations, and supervise administrative organs to strictly handle matters in accordance with statutory authority, conditions, and procedures, and provide fair and reasonable compensation. Continuously implement the "3+N" working mechanism for the prevention and substantive resolution of administrative disputes, coordinate with relevant departments to formulate and improve targeted normative documents in areas such as the national unified market, market supervision and management, securities and futures, and financial regulation, and actively prevent and resolve administrative disputes involving private economic organizations.

3. Lawfully regulate monopolistic and unfair competition practices. Strengthen judicial efforts in anti-monopoly and anti-unfair competition, and lawfully regulate acts that undermine fair competition or disrupt market order. Adjudicate monopoly dispute cases in the field of science and technology in accordance with the law, accurately distinguish between the normal exercise of intellectual property rights and acts that abuse intellectual property rights to exclude or restrict competition, ensure that all types of enterprises have fair access to innovation resources, achieve the reasonable allocation and efficient use of innovation resources, and actively promote the construction of a unified market.

4. Lawfully assist in broadening financing channels. Implement the provisions of the Civil Code on functional security, support private economic organizations in relying on the supply chain and industrial chain to develop new financing guarantee methods, lawfully confirm the legal validity of atypical guarantees, stabilize the legal expectations of financial institutions, and assist private economic organizations in effectively utilizing their own assets and resources to obtain credit financing. Continuously improve working mechanisms for the centralized collection and sharing of credit information, work with relevant departments to maintain enterprise credit information, and timely update information on enterprise litigation and enforcement to prevent delays in information updates from affecting enterprises' ability to obtain normal financing. Cooperate with market supervision, the People's Bank of China, and other comprehensive credit management departments to promptly restore credit in accordance with laws and regulations. Strictly implement national financial management policies, strengthen communication with financial regulatory authorities, promote financial institutions to continuously optimize inclusive financial supply and services, regulate interest collection in accordance with the law, and collaborate to promote policy implementation. Lawfully regulate the unilateral addition of loan conditions, suspension of loan disbursement, and early recovery of loans by financial institutions, ensuring that the lawful rights and interests of private economic organizations are not infringed upon. Lawfully regulate illegal professional lending and relending acts such as "usurious loans" and "deducting interest from the principal upfront," severely punish criminal activities in private lending, regulate and guide the order of private financing, and assist private economic organizations in solving the difficulties of "financing difficulties" and "high financing costs."

5. Focus on promoting the resolution of outstanding payments owed to private economic organizations. Strictly implement the rigid provisions on payment of accounts under the Private Economy Promotion Law, the Regulations on Guaranteeing the Payment of Amounts Owed to Small and Medium-sized Enterprises, and the Reply on the Validity of Clauses Where Large Enterprises and Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Agree to Use Payment by Third Parties as a Condition for Payment, and ensure timely payment of accounts owed to private economic organizations, especially small and medium-sized enterprises. Relying on the inter-ministerial joint meeting mechanism for clearing outstanding payments, further improve the prevention and clearance mechanism for outstanding payments owed to private economic organizations, fully implement the "green channel" work requirements for expedited filing, expedited preservation, expedited adjudication, and expedited enforcement, strengthen enforcement against entities that owe payments, and actively use cross-enforcement to enhance the enforcement of cases involving outstanding payments owed to private economic organizations.

6. Strengthen judicial protection of scientific and technological innovation. While increasing the protection of intellectual property rights for innovation achievements, it is also necessary to curb malicious intellectual property litigation and false litigation, and optimize the legal environment for innovation and entrepreneurship. Adjudicate intellectual property cases involving high-tech fields in accordance with the law, and enhance the level of judicial protection for scientific and technological innovation achievements in key areas and core technologies. Study and formulate guiding opinions on the application of punitive damages, improve adjudication rules, refine identification standards, and effectively realize the institutional value of intellectual property punitive damages in punishing infringing acts, effectively remedying rights, and incentivizing innovation and creation. Actively address the issue of "waiting for one case to be resolved before another" in situations where civil and administrative patent cases intersect, as well as the inconsistency of adjudication standards, and strive to achieve procedural coherence and outcome coordination in the adjudication of cross-overlapping civil and administrative patent cases; work with the National Intellectual Property Administration to establish and improve a collaborative mechanism for case adjudication, accelerate the administrative procedures for patent confirmation related to civil patent cases, and promote substantive dispute resolution. Increase efforts to coordinate the adjudication of batch intellectual property rights enforcement cases, and unify the adjudication standards for such cases nationwide by issuing typical cases and guidance norms.

7. Ensure the healthy and orderly development of emerging industries. Study and draft guiding opinions on the judicial protection of data property rights, properly handle data rights disputes, and promote the efficient circulation and transaction of data elements. Adjudicate cases involving artificial intelligence in accordance with the law, support the lawful application of artificial intelligence, and guide the healthy and orderly development of the artificial intelligence industry.

III. Guide Law-abiding and Standardized Operations in Accordance with the Law, Promote the Healthy Development of the Private Economy

8. Lawfully punish crimes such as internal corruption within private economic organizations and other criminal acts. Accurately grasp the legal application standards for corruption crime cases involving private economic organizations, and timely issue guiding cases and typical cases to assist in the normalization of legal publicity activities in private economic organizations. Strengthen research and guidance, lawfully punish and effectively curb crimes of bid rigging, fully leverage the warning, deterrent, and educational effects of cases, and guide and regulate the order of the market economy.

9. Promote the improvement of internal governance. In disputes among shareholders of private economic organizations, actively guide the substantive resolution of operational deadlocks through means such as equity transfer, equity buyback, capital reduction, or division by exercising the right of clarification in accordance with the law, preventing internal governance disorder from impeding enterprise production and operation. Strictly adhere to the principle of corporate property independence, strengthen the regulation of the behavior of controlling shareholders and actual controllers, and lawfully hold controlling shareholders and actual controllers accountable for abuses of dominant position, such as "hollowing out" the enterprise through related-party transactions, non-operational occupation of enterprise funds, and illegal guarantees that shift risks to the enterprise. Take measures to protect the modern enterprise property rights structure characterized by mutual independence of property between shareholders and the company, separation of liabilities, and clear property rights structures, and effectively protect the rights and interests of minority shareholders.

10. Guide honest and law-abiding operations. Fairly adjudicate various contract dispute cases arising from the production and operation debts of private economic organizations, and continuously guide the enhancement of the rule of law awareness, contractual spirit, and compliance concepts of private economic organizations. Strengthen communication and coordination with market supervision departments, further improve market exit mechanisms such as liquidation and deregistration for abnormally operating enterprises, strengthen the legal liability of relevant liquidation subjects for neglecting their duties, and lawfully combat dishonest acts such as evading debts. Lawfully punish crimes committed by enterprises that undermine financial management order, engage in financial fraud, harm tax collection and management, infringe upon intellectual property rights, or disrupt market order, and improve judicial adjudication rules and intensify lawful punishment for prominent criminal issues. Severely punish acts that damage the ecological environment, prevent development at the cost of pollution, and promote the transformation and upgrading of the development model of private economic organizations.

11. Promote the construction of harmonious labor relations. Accurately apply the Supreme People's Court's Interpretation (II) on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Adjudication of Labor Dispute Cases, strengthen the protection of workers' rights and interests, and pay attention to balancing the protection of the lawful rights and interests of both employers and workers in accordance with the law. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with relevant departments, leverage the role of the arbitration and litigation linkage mechanism, unify the standards for the application of law, promote the implementation of the work of "one letter and two documents" (a labor dispute prevention mechanism), guide enterprises to standardize employment, and promote diversified resolution of labor dispute conflicts. Continuously strengthen research on the protection of the rights and interests of workers in new forms of employment, publish typical cases, and support and regulate the development of new forms of employment.

12. Lawfully adjudicate consumer dispute cases. Publish typical cases on online consumption, guide business operators to operate in a standardized manner, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of the online economy and platform economy. Implement the punitive damages system for food and pharmaceutical products, lawfully regulate "knowingly buying fake goods," protect the lawful rights and interests of consumers, and also lawfully punish illegal claims, protect the lawful rights and interests of operators, and maintain normal production and operation order. Lawfully adjudicate civil dispute cases involving prepaid consumption, guide operators to operate in good faith, support the financing function of prepaid consumption, reduce operating costs, promote investment, and also lawfully combat acts that harm consumer rights, such as operators "absconding with funds," "overbearing clauses," and non-refund of payments, to maintain good market order.

13. Assist private economic organizations in safely "going global." Study and formulate opinions on promoting the high-quality development of international commercial courts, further improve the "one-stop" diversified resolution mechanism for international commercial disputes that organically links litigation, arbitration, and mediation, focus on playing the role of cross-border commercial mediation, and provide more efficient, convenient, and low-cost international commercial dispute resolution mechanisms to serve and guarantee the active participation of various private economic organizations in the joint construction of the "Belt and Road." Timely issue guiding cases where the parties have agreed on jurisdiction and the application of foreign law. Publish reports on foreign-related commercial adjudication and typical cases involving the "Belt and Road" construction, guide enterprises "going global" to actively enhance risk prevention awareness, and guide them to operate in compliance with laws and regulations.

IV. Adhere to Strict and Impartial Justice, Protect the Lawful Rights and Interests of Private Economic Organizations and Their Operators in Accordance with the Law

14. Strengthen judicial protection of property rights. Lawfully punish crimes that undermine the order of the socialist market economy, insist on a full-chain crackdown, and severely punish crimes such as extortion, forced transactions, and gathering crowds to disrupt enterprise production and operation order. Research and issue a judicial interpretation on the adjudication of cases involving the intersection of civil and criminal matters, conduct in-depth research and guidance on legal issues related to the crime of contract fraud, and, on the basis of adhering to strict and impartial adjudication in accordance with the law, strictly distinguish between economic disputes and economic crimes, and resolutely prevent the handling of economic disputes as economic crimes.

15. Standardize the disposal of property involved in cases. Accurately apply the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Regulating the Enforcement of Property-related Parts of Criminal Judgments, improve the working mechanism for the enforcement of property-related parts of criminal judgments, fully utilize the means of criminal asset recovery and restitution, protect the property rights of private economic organizations and their operators as victims, and strictly distinguish between illegal gains, other property involved in the case, and lawful property; between the property of private economic organizations and the personal property of their operators; and between the property of the persons involved and the property of third parties, ensuring that the lawful operations of enterprises are not affected, and that the lawful rights and interests of individuals and third parties are not violated.

16. Lawfully correct wrongful convictions in cases involving enterprises. Lawfully retry and correct wrongful convictions in cases involving enterprises, and strictly review whether compulsory measures restricting personal freedom comply with statutory authority, conditions, and procedures. Promptly publish typical cases of wrongful conviction correction through retrial, resolutely ensure that errors are corrected and corrected in accordance with the law. Improve the working mechanism for identifying and correcting wrongful convictions in cases involving enterprises, establish and maintain work ledgers, and actively conduct specialized evaluations. Increase the intensity of higher courts taking over cases and directly adjudicating them, improve the system for designating courts in other places to conduct retrials, and prevent procedural ping-pong. Strengthen the tracking, guidance, and supervision of cases designated for retrial or sent back for retrial, and strive to improve adjudication quality and efficiency as well as judicial credibility.

17. Lawfully protect the personality rights of private economic organizations and their operators. Lawfully severely punish illegal acts of online violence that harm enterprises, and lawfully combat crimes that infringe upon the reputation rights of private economic organizations and the personal dignity and privacy rights of their operators. Fully leverage the functions of the personality rights infringement prohibition order and the behavioral preservation system, promptly stop illegal acts such as malicious defamation of the reputation of private economic organizations and their operators, actively publish typical cases and push them into the case database, and further demonstrate the exemplary and guiding role of fair adjudication. Deepen research on the application of laws concerning personality rights such as the right to name, reputation right, and honor right of private economic organizations, and the reputation right, honor right, privacy right, and personal information of operators of private economic organizations, and guide the strict and standardized application of the Personality Rights Chapter of the Civil Code.

V. Improve the Systems and Mechanisms for Impartial Justice, Continuously Enhance the Effectiveness of Judicial Guarantees

18. Improve diversified dispute resolution mechanisms. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era, and promote the improvement of mechanisms for the prevention and diversified resolution of conflicts and disputes from the source. Actively participate in the standardized construction of comprehensive social governance centers, fulfill the function of guiding mediation, and promote professional mediation in areas such as people's mediation, administrative mediation, commercial chamber mediation, and lawyer mediation, to better leverage the effectiveness of conflict prevention and resolution. Deepen the requirements of legalizing petition work, and strengthen the resolution of litigation-related petitions. Deepen the construction of the "Zong dui Zong" (headquarters-to-headquarters) mechanism, solidly advance the work of the people's court mediation platform "entering villages, entering communities, and entering grids," strengthen collaboration with the Federation of Industry and Commerce and other units, and effectively reduce the costs for private economic organizations to resolve disputes and escape difficulties.

19. Continuously optimize litigation services. Adhere to the case registration system unwaveringly, ensure that all lawsuits that meet the legal requirements are filed and handled, and optimize three-dimensional and diversified services such as on-site case filing, online case filing, and cross-regional case filing. Leverage the role of pre-litigation mediation and diversified dispute resolution mechanisms; for cases that can be mediated first, carry out non-litigation resolution and diversified resolution of conflicts and disputes through relevant working mechanisms. Increase the promotion and application of model complaint forms and answer forms, actively guide private economic organizations to use model forms and express their demands in accordance with the law, and continuously enhance the sense of gain for all types of business operators in using model forms for convenient, efficient, and substantive resolution of conflicts and disputes.

20. Standardize the application of preservation measures. Conduct litigation preservation work in a lawful and prudent manner, strictly prohibit the sealing up, seizure, or freezing of property beyond authority, scope, amount, or time limit, and use "flexible sealing and seizure" methods as much as possible to reduce the impact on the lawful production and operation activities of private economic organizations. Improve the coordination and connection mechanism between case filing, adjudication, and enforcement, fully perform the mediation function at the case filing stage, timely explain to the parties of litigation preservation the advantages of mediation for efficient and rapid dispute resolution, guide the parties to reach a settlement and substantive resolution, and effectively implement "promoting mediation through preservation" and "promoting enforcement through preservation." Lawfully adjudicate dispute cases involving compensation for litigation preservation, clarify recourse rules, lawfully confirm liability for wrongful preservation, guide parties to exercise litigation preservation rights in accordance with the law, punish abuse of litigation rights, and prevent disputes arising from wrongful preservation.

21. Lawfully standardize enforcement work. Standardize property investigation to avoid wrongful seizure of third-party property. Standardize property sealing and seizure, strictly prohibit sealing and seizure that clearly exceeds the subject matter, and prioritize the execution of property that has a minor impact on the production and life of the person subject to enforcement and is convenient for execution. Standardize property disposition, promptly initiate the price realization procedure for property that has been controlled in accordance with the law, lawfully determine the reference price for property disposition, fully and truthfully disclose the property information that has been found during the auction and sale process, and allow the person subject to enforcement to dispose of the property themselves under certain conditions. Standardize compulsory measures and indirect enforcement measures; when adopting fines and detention measures, strictly follow the approval process and apply them in a standardized manner in accordance with the law; when adopting measures such as travel restrictions, credit sanctions, and consumption restrictions, strictly review whether the person subject to enforcement meets the statutory conditions; when circumstances for lifting the measures arise, they shall be lifted promptly within the specified time.

22. Improve the mechanisms for discipline against dishonesty and credit restoration. Strictly carry out discipline against dishonesty in accordance with laws and regulations, reasonably determine the scope and intensity of such discipline, accurately distinguish between "dishonesty" and "inability to perform," give full play to the incentivizing role of graded and classified discipline against dishonesty and creditworthiness rewards, and for business entities that have committed minor dishonest acts but actively correct them, temporarily refrain from including them in the dishonesty list with the consent of the applicant for enforcement. For dishonest actors with general dishonest conduct, a grace period may be granted, and the assets of the business entity may be revitalized through methods such as performance by installments under settlement, merger and reorganization, or introduction of third-party funds. Actively utilize systems such as the grace period for dishonesty discipline and one-time removal of restrictions to promote judgment debtors' active fulfillment of adjudicatory obligations and settlement between the parties in enforcement, achieving "win-win and all-win." Establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism for dishonesty levels, adjusting the credit rating of the judgment debtor every six months based on the status of fulfillment of obligations. Further smooth channels for credit restoration. Where a dishonest judgment debtor actively fulfills adjudicatory obligations or voluntarily corrects dishonest acts, the people's court shall promptly assist in restoring their credit and issue supporting materials, enabling the business entity to promptly return to the normal track of production and operation. Strengthen coordination and linkage with the National Development and Reform Commission, financial institutions, market regulation authorities, and other entities, promote credit rating agencies to optimize rating methods for private economic organizations, promote mutual sharing and recognition of restoration results, and increase the effective supply of credit ratings.

23. Resolutely rectify prominent issues in trials and enforcement involving enterprises. Carry out a special campaign to regulate law enforcement and judicial activities involving enterprises in a solid manner, continuously consolidate and deepen the results of the special campaign, effectively enhance confidence through equal protection in accordance with the law, stabilize expectations through strict and fair justice, and stimulate vitality through good-faith and civilized justice. Adhere to the basic principle of "statutory jurisdiction as the rule, designated jurisdiction as the exception," strictly prevent profit-driven law enforcement, and resolutely rectify the expansion of jurisdiction over cases involving private economic organizations and the artificial creation of cross-regional jurisdiction. Effectively and efficiently rectify non-standard enforcement practices involving private economic organizations and their operators, minimizing the impact of enforcement measures on the normal production and operation of enterprises.

24. Enhance the efficiency of foreign-related adjudication. Improve the convenience mechanism for cross-border litigation, accelerate the revision of the foreign-related part of the judicial interpretation of the Civil Procedure Law, and further refine procedural rules such as foreign-related jurisdiction and service. Improve the mechanism for ascertaining foreign law, establishing a high-level and specialized work system for ascertaining foreign laws. Explore the establishment of a fast-track mechanism for the trial and handling of small-amount foreign-related disputes to prevent litigation from affecting the production and operation of small, medium, and micro private economic organizations. Improve the mechanism for the accurate application of international treaties and practices, refine the mechanism for cross-border recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards and civil and commercial judgments, strengthen trial supervision and guidance, unify adjudicative standards, and effectively enhance the capability and level of foreign-related adjudication. Further improve the quality and efficiency of handling judicial assistance cases, assisting private economic organizations in better safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests overseas through judicial assistance channels.

25. Strengthen legal publicity and education. Based on the actual situation of judicial trials, earnestly implement the responsibility system of "those who enforce the law shall popularize the law," fully elucidate the role of the Private Economy Promotion Law in guaranteeing the rule of law and guiding norms, and effectively carry out the publicity and education work on the Private Economy Promotion Law. Strengthen the interpretation of law through cases, give full play to the leading, exemplary, educational, and warning role of typical cases, so that private economic organizations and their operators can "understand and use" the law.

People's courts at all levels shall regard the study, publicity, and implementation of the Private Economy Promotion Law as a major political task, strengthen organizational leadership, reinforce the implementation of responsibilities, and promptly study and resolve new situations and problems arising from the implementation of work. All adjudication business departments of the Supreme People's Court shall strengthen vertical guidance, fully utilize platforms such as the Case Database of the People's Courts and the Fa Da Wang (Legal Q&A Network) platform, and effectively carry out trial supervision and guidance. When adjudicating cases involving the private economy, courts in various regions shall, in light of actual circumstances, cite the relevant provisions of the Private Economy Promotion Law, and shall refine and improve implementation measures based on the actual economic and social development of their respective regions, ensuring that measures are practical, effective, and produce results on the ground. The implementation of the Private Economy Promotion Law shall be included as an important content of the judicial inspection by the people's courts, promoting the detailed implementation of the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the Private Economy Promotion Law in judicial adjudication work.
